question: What are the most influential papers on synthetic gene circuits? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on synthetic gene circuits, based on citation counts, include foundational work on CRISPR-based gene expression control, the construction of genetic toggle switches in E. coli, and modular RNA-guided regulation in eukaryotes.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2013.02.022","title":"Repurposing CRISPR as an RNA-Guided Platform for Sequence-Specific Control of Gene Expression","citation_count":4488},{"doi":"10.1038/35002131","title":"Construction of a genetic toggle switch in Escherichia coli","citation_count":3641},{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2013.06.044","title":"CRISPR-Mediated Modular RNA-Guided Regulation of Transcription in Eukaryotes","citation_count":3382},{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2014.09.039","title":"A Protein-Tagging System for Signal Amplification in Gene Expression and Fluorescence Imaging","citation_count":1441},{"doi":"10.1038/nature09326","title":"Functional roles for noise in genetic circuits","citation_count":1324}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on synthetic gene circuits, based on citation counts, include foundational work on CRISPR-based gene expression control, the construction of genetic toggle switches in E. coli, and modular RNA-guided regulation in eukaryotes.
